name: Tanados UI
description: Tanados UI rebrands Jellyfin Web automatically with the Tanados logo/colors and adds the enhanced MonWUI/JMSFusion experience layer.
overview: Tanados-branded Jellyfin Web UI upgrade with automatic logo replacement, purple/gold theme accents, cinematic sliders, enhanced details, playback, profiles, watchlist, and settings.

versions.changelog:
v2.8.1.1

Fixes:
- Fixed Tanados UI Settings failing to load because settingsPage.js could indirectly request a missing Bulgarian language module: /slider/language/bul_bg.js
- Added bul_bg.js as a compatibility alias and switched the language index to the existing bul.js module
- Set the default preferred trailer language to bg-BG
- Updated build packaging to write Jellyfin's expected MD5 checksum into manifest.json

Notes:
- Restart Jellyfin after installing or updating
- Perform a hard browser refresh (Ctrl + F5) after updating
- If the old settings error remains, clear browser cache for the Jellyfin server address
